[createPrivatePropertyTranspiler(options)](./utilities-for-private-properties.createprivatepropertytranspiler.md)


</td><td>

Create a transpiler for private custom properties.

The returned transpiler keeps its state between calls, so that generated names do not collide when it is used for multiple subtrees of one file. Nodes must already be attached to a tree.
